Definition: from G4253 and G2784; to herald (i.e. proclaim) in advance:--before (first) preach.
BiblicalUsage: Prokerysso means to herald in advance, to preach before. Luke uses it once: when John had first preached before his coming the baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe John's preaching before was the voice preparing the way, and the herald always comes before the King.
